title: parathelypteris beddomei
intro: Parathelypteris beddomei, commonly known as Beddome's fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Parathelypteris beddomei include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help in reducing inflammation, fever, and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
